astrometry_match_v_0_<N>: Holds astrometric match results; one row per matched field-run (one match record) as indicated by id/FIELDID/FIELDNUM; notable keys/measures: id, FIELDID, FIELDNUM, FIELDNAME, FIELDOBJS, NMATCH, NVERIFIED, NAGREE, NINDEX, NCONFLICT, NDISTRACT, STARS, QUAD, QUADPIX, DIMQUADS, QUADXYZ, CENTERXYZ, CRPIX, CRVAL, CD, PARITY, HEALPIX, HPNSIDE, RADIUS, LOGODDS, WORSTLOGODDS, QMATCHED, QTRIED, QSCALEOK, QPEERS, QPEERS, QMATCHED, TIMEUSED, WCS_VALID, INDEXID, INDEXID, IDS, INDEXID
photos_v_0_<N>: Stores uploaded photo metadata; one row per uploaded image (id); notable keys/measures: id, upload_session_id, user, storage_uri, image_bucket, image_type, model, make, equatorial_mount, is_mobile, detected_circle, vision_labels, camera_datetime, image_datetime, uploaded_date, datetime_repaired, lat, lon, height, width, aperture_value, exposure_time, totality, state
astrometry_index_v_0_<N>: Contains astrometric index points; one row per index point (id); notable keys/measures: id, X, Y
astrometry_corr_v_0_<N>: Records correspondences between field detections and index points; one row per correspondence (id) linking a field and an index entry; notable keys/measures: id, field_id, index_id, field_x, field_y, field_ra, field_dec, index_x, index_y, index_ra, index_dec, FLUX, BACKGROUND, match_weight
astrometry_rdls_v_0_<N>: Lists reference sky coordinates; one row per reference object (id); notable keys/measures: id, RA, DEC
